Res.Caption: Published
Res.FullDescription: Published boards are visible to everyone. Unpublished boards are only visible to the board's owner and anyone in the board's Release Group.

Res.Caption: Global
Res.FullDescription: Global boards are available to all users. Non-global boards are only available to users belonging to the current logged in company.

Res.Caption: Release Group
Res.FullDescription: The group of resources who will have permission to view this board and edit if applicable.

Res.Caption: Aging Branch
Res.FullDescription: The branch to use when calculating aging of cards for this board. If none is selected, the branch of the component will be used.

Res.Caption: Aging Department
Res.FullDescription: The department to use when calculating aging of cards for this board. If none is selected, the department of the component will be used.
